# Code of Conduct

The Raz project is committed to a professional, constructive, and technically focused community.

Contributors are expected to:

- treat other participants with respect;
- critique ideas and code rather than people;
- keep technical discussions focused on evidence, tradeoffs, and project goals;
- avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, or targeted hostility;
- respect maintainer decisions while continuing to challenge technical choices constructively;
- avoid publishing private or security-sensitive information without permission.

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content and may restrict participation when behavior repeatedly disrupts the project.

If a problem needs private attention, contact the maintainers through an appropriate private GitHub channel.
